briefings.title: Private Markets and The Future of Capital Allocation with Marc Rowan | The a16z Show

people.name: Marc Rowan
people.role: Cofounder, CEO, and Chair of Apollo Global Management

briefings.tldr: As public markets face extreme concentration, Apollo Global Management is scaling past $1 trillion in assets by shifting from traditional private equity to investment-grade private credit—bridging long-term retirement liabilities with the massive, capital-intensive infrastructure demands of AI, energy, and robotics.

briefings.title: Goldman Sachs Chairman on AI and the Future of Finance | The a16z Show
briefings.tldr: True risk management is rooted in contingency planning rather than prediction, requiring leaders to distinguish between being "wrong" and being "reckless" while maintaining a long-term "partnership" culture that prioritizes the institution over the individual.

briefings.title: The Investor Behind Costco, Starbucks, and Blackstone | Tony James on The a16z Show
briefings.tldr: Wall Street legend Tony James outlines the strategic decisions that drove historic growth at DLJ, Costco, and Blackstone, emphasizing how rigorous investment committee debate, aggressive retail distribution, and disciplined succession planning build enduring financial franchises.

briefings.title: "We're Not Writing Code by Hand Anymore. That's Over." | Owen Jennings & David Haber - The a16z Show

people.name: Owen Jennings
people.role: Executive Officer and Business Lead, Block

briefings.tldr: Block (formerly Square) recently executed a 40%+ reduction in force (RIF) driven by a paradigm shift where AI agents and "squads of three" now outperform traditional teams of 14, effectively decoupling company output from human headcount.

briefings.title: Ben Horowitz & David Solomon on Why Scale Is The Only Thing That Matters
briefings.tldr: The current macro environment offers a "sweet spot" for financial assets, driven by significant stimulus and a capital investment super cycle that's poised to drive strong M&A and IPO activity.
